# Introduction
Unify use-cases into a single-plot, run in scripts:
- `6_Figure.Rmd` : Human lung atlas for club cells into nasal/non-nasal cell splitting, according to authors (proof of concept) :: supported by ISC
- `Heart_atlas` : Human heart atlas for ventricular cardiomycites (vCM) splitting :: not supported by ISC
- `Stressed_Tcells.Rmd`: Chu pan-cancer T cell atlas, focuses on Yost dataset. Show some T subtypes lack of ISC, no reannotation proposed.

Annotations and reannotation (when applicable) has been cached at `cache/`

# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, 
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
```

```{r libraries}
# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(BiocParallel)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(Seurat)
library(scTypeEval)
source("helpers/consistency_exploration.R")

# Custom theme
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 12))
```

# 1. Load consistencies
```{r}
cons_files <- file.path("cache", c(
   "HCLA_consistencies.rds",
   "HCLA_consistencies_authorsReannot.rds",
   "Heart_consistencies.rds",
   "Heart_consistencies_authorsReannot_VCM.rds",
   "Tstr_consistencies.rds"
))

cons_keep <- c(
               "ISC_local" = "silhouette | recip_classif:Match",
               #"ISC_global" = "2label_silhouette | Pseudobulk:Cosine",
               "SCCAF" = "SCCAF | NA",
               "MetaNeighbor" = "MetaNeighbor_Supervised | NA",
               "cLISI" = "nsa_cLISI | NA"
               )
```

## Gene marker assessment

The qualitative assessments below document the marker-based judgments from the
individual notebooks; they are not calculated from the consistency scores.
The stressed CD4 label is written as `CD4.Tstr` to match the cached data
(`CD4.Str` in the original assessment table).

```{r}
marker_assessment <- tibble::tribble(
   ~dataset_annot,       ~celltype,                    ~marker_assessment,
   "HLCA_original",      "club.cell",                  "bad",
   "HLCA_reannotated",   "Club.(nasal)",               "good",
   "HLCA_reannotated",   "Club.(non.nasal)",           "good",
   "Heart_original",     "Ventricular.Cardiomyocyte", "good",
   "Heart_reannotated",  "vCM1",                       "bad",
   "Heart_reannotated",  "vCM2",                       "bad",
   "Heart_reannotated",  "vCM3",                       "bad",
   "Heart_reannotated",  "vCM4",                       "bad",
   "Heart_reannotated",  "vCM5",                       "bad",
   "Tstr_original",      "CD4.Treg",                   "good",
   "Tstr_original",      "CD8.p.Tex",                  "bad",
   "Tstr_original",      "CD8.Tcm",                    "bad",
   "Tstr_original",      "CD4.Tstr",                   "bad",
   "Tstr_original",      "CD4.Tcm",                    "good"
)
```

For the stressed T-cell analysis, the original qualitative method comparisons
were documented as follows:

| Cell type | local_ISC | SCCAF | MetaNeighbor | Gene marker |
|-----------|-----------|-------|--------------|-------------|
| CD4.Treg  | good | good | good | good |
| CD8.p.Tex | bad | bad | good | bad |
| CD8.Tcm   | bad | good | mid | bad |
| CD4.Tstr  | bad | good | bad | bad |
| CD4.Tcm   | good | mid | bad | good |

```{r}
cons <- lapply(cons_files, function(f){
   df <- readRDS(f)
   nn <- basename(f)
   ds <- strsplit(nn, split = "_")[[1]][1]
   if (ds == "HCLA") ds <- "HLCA"
   annot <- ifelse(grepl("reannot", nn, ignore.case = T),
                   "reannotated", "original")
   
   df %>% 
      mutate(method_type = paste(consistency_metric,
                                 dissimilarity_method,
                                 sep = " | ")) %>% 
      filter(method_type %in% cons_keep) %>% 
      mutate(method_type = factor(method_type,
                                  levels = cons_keep,
                                  labels = names(cons_keep)),
             dataset = ds,
             annot = annot,
             dataset_annot = paste(dataset, annot, sep = "_")) %>% 
      select(celltype, method_type, measure, ident, dataset, annot, dataset_annot)
}) %>% 
   data.table::rbindlist()
```

# 2. Build summarizing plot
The tile text shows the score rounded to two decimal places. Color shows the
score's percentile rank among **all** cell types for the same method and
dataset-annotation, before selecting the cell types in the assessment table.
Higher percentiles correspond to higher scores; tied scores share the lowest
rank in the tie. Orange indicates lower percentiles and blue higher percentiles;
gray tiles indicate missing scores. The gene marker column shows the separate
qualitative assessment, with orange for bad and blue for good.

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=10}
panel_labels <- c(
   HLCA_original = "Lung Atlas | Broad (original)",
   HLCA_reannotated = "Lung Atlas | Fine (reannotation)",
   Heart_original = "Heart Atlas | Broad (original)",
   Heart_reannotated = "Heart Atlas | Fine (reannotation)",
   Tstr_original = "Intra-tumoral T cells | original"
)
celltype_levels <- rev(unique(marker_assessment$celltype))

ranked_cons <- cons %>%
   group_by(dataset_annot, method_type) %>%
   mutate(rank_percentile = percent_rank(measure)) %>%
   ungroup()

plot_data <- tidyr::crossing(
   marker_assessment %>% select(dataset_annot, celltype),
   method_type = factor(names(cons_keep), levels = names(cons_keep))
) %>%
   left_join(ranked_cons, by = c("dataset_annot", "celltype", "method_type")) %>%
   mutate(
      dataset_annot = factor(dataset_annot, levels = names(panel_labels)),
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels),
      score_label = ifelse(is.na(measure), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", measure))
   )

marker_plot <- marker_assessment %>%
   mutate(
      dataset_annot = factor(dataset_annot, levels = names(panel_labels)),
      celltype = factor(celltype, levels = celltype_levels)
   )

allpl <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = method_type, y = celltype, fill = rank_percentile)) +
   geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
   geom_text(aes(label = score_label,
                 color = !is.na(rank_percentile) & rank_percentile > 0.85),
             size = 3.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
   geom_tile(data = filter(marker_plot, marker_assessment == "bad"),
             aes(x = "Gene marker", y = celltype), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             fill = "#fdae61", color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
   geom_tile(data = filter(marker_plot, marker_assessment == "good"),
             aes(x = "Gene marker", y = celltype), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             fill = "#08519c", color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
   geom_text(data = marker_plot,
             aes(x = "Gene marker", y = celltype, label = marker_assessment,
                 color = marker_assessment == "good"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
   facet_grid(dataset_annot ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
              labeller = as_labeller(panel_labels)) +
   scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#fdae61", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#08519c",
                        midpoint = 0.25, limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey90",
                        name = "Score\npercentile",
                        labels = scales::label_percent()) +
   scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey15", "TRUE" = "white")) +
   scale_x_discrete(position = "top", limits = c(names(cons_keep), "Gene marker")) +
   labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
        caption = "Percentiles are calculated within each dataset, annotation and method.") +
   theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
   theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.35, "cm"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust = 0),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "grey15"),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, color = "grey40")
   )

allpl
```
